messages:
maya: FYI Qbringup q2b-int4 staging shows a small but consistent drop on localization promptset vs qx2b. failures look like paraphrase/format drift rather than hallucinations. :thinking_face:
santiago: can you drop a reproducible example (multilang + en)?
maya: mostly es/fr/ja. example: 
```
prompt: 'Resume esto en 3 puntos'
golden: 'Resumen: 1) ... 2) ... 3) ...'
qx2b: 'Resumen: 1) ... 2) ... 3) ...'
q2b-int4: 'Puntos principales: ...'  <-- loses bullet structure
```
eli: could be dedupe removed anchor paraphrases, or tokenizer differences under int4 path. we had seedbank overlap last week.
anya: I ran embed-recall diffs 10m ago 12: q2b-int4 embeddings shift slightly vs qx2b, but structural drop points to tokenization/truncation.
danny: labeler queue shows more "ambiguous" flags on these prompts. might be dedupe collapsing anchors and leaving fewer stable references.
maya: hypothesis: rolling dedupe pruned longtail anchors for locales, losing coverage. need to snapshot anchors in golden for previous model and compare.
santiago: SQL I will run to extract anchors by hash and model_version: 
```sql
SELECT anchor_id, text, hash, model_version FROM golden_anchors WHERE model_version IN ('qx2b-2025','q2b-int4-staging') ORDER BY anchor_id;
```
I'll diff hashes and counts and upload results.
labeling-bot: created review batch rb_20260321_b, size=90, locales=[es,fr,ja], priority=high, queue=multilang-anchors.
anya: suggest manual relabel of 30 stratified examples first (locale, length) to confirm delta before broad changes.
eli: I can do es/fr manual pass tomorrow morning. santi take ja?
santiago: yes. will also run provenance diff and upload CSV to /tmp/qbringup-anchor-diff.csv.
danny: ops note 12: staging autoscale bumped GPUs last night; also ops-bot shows kernel flag tweak. ops-bot: runtime flag update on 2026-03-20 02:12 UTC: kernel_path_optimizer=on applied to q2b-int4-staging nodes.
maya: that flag was part of perf tuning; could affect tokenization boundary handling. propose A/B: same model but with kernel_path_optimizer=off on a small canary pool and route 10% traffic.
santiago: will spin canary pool and route 10%. adding metric "anchor_stability" = fraction of canary prompts whose top-1 structure matches golden.
anya: for the manual batch add label field: structure_match (yes/no/partial) + freeform note. will help identify ordering/formatting vs content loss.
danny: updated labeling template 12: structure_match enum added and backfilled.
labeling-bot: reviewers assigned: eli (es/fr), santiago (ja). batch rb_20260321_b in progress.
maya: timeline: manual review by EOD tomorrow, provenance diff and kernel A/B by lunch, then decision: rollback flag or expand golden anchors.
eli: if we expand golden anchors, we must version eval harness promptset (v2) and keep v1 for historical metrics. will copy notes into qbringup ticket.
santiago: uploaded /tmp/qbringup-anchor-diff.csv 12: summary: es -14 anchors removed, fr -6 removed, ja 0 removed. starting ja review.
anya: I'll draft a small rule: if dedupe removes anchors such that locale_anchor_count < N_min, raise a review ticket. opening PR now. :hammer_and_wrench:
maya: request: every golden set change must include a 2-line justification in the commit (why add/remove). audit trail is required. :memo:
ops-bot: reminder deploy freeze today 18:00-20:00 UTC.
eli: copying manual labels into ticket and will ping when pass complete.
maya: thanks all 12: we'll reconvene after reviews to decide rollback vs anchor expansion. :white_check_mark:
